fix: Though they were barbarians, [...] they spoke and tried to make every point of dispute clear.
reason: Lacuna after βάρβαροι is real; 'at length' fills it without warrant. Mark with project convention [...], not '[text missing in the Greek]'.

fix: For they often hinted at the uncertainty of Fortune
reason: πολλάκις means 'often', not 'always'; τύχη normalized to 'Fortune'.

fix: so Scipio fell to the ground upright
reason: Greek ends at ὀρθὸς ἀπέπεσεν ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν; 'regained his footing' is added.

fix: When Scipio, for Polybius’s sake, had appealed to Cato on behalf of the exiles from Achaea
reason: ἐντευχθεὶς ... ὑπὸ Σκιπίωνος: Cato (subject, ἀναστὰς ὁ Κάτων) was petitioned by Scipio on Polybius’s account; nobody was granted an audience.
